audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text and whys[6] both say Tahm Kench has a 'global R' he roams with. He does not.
audit.why: Abyssal Voyage — the old global ferry — was removed. His current ultimate is Devour: he eats a champion for a few seconds, damaging an enemy or shielding an ally. There is no map-wide roam on it. The blink that actually exists is Abyssal Dive (W, 21s at rank 1 down to 17s, 1000 to 1200 range), and he has had it since level 2. The mirror file reaches the same conclusion from his side.
audit.corrected: Both strings now describe Devour and Abyssal Dive instead of a global ultimate.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block calls Tongue Lash 'his stun' with no condition and no number.
audit.why: Tongue Lash (Q, 7s at rank 1 down to 5s, 900 range) slows and heals him and applies one stack of An Acquired Taste. It only stuns if you already carry three stacks — and spending the stun consumes them, so the stun and Devour compete for the same three stacks and cannot be chained. Thick Skin (E) sits on a 3-second cooldown and converts stored damage into a shield, which is why chip poke into a full Thick Skin nets you nothing.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block now carries the 3-stack condition, the real Q number, and the Thick Skin 3s.
